name: Bachelor of Arts in Language and Literary Studies (Mahikeng)
notes: Campuses: Mahikeng. School of Languages. Requirements apply per language subject chosen, not to the whole programme. Prerequisites: Afrikaans: Afrikaans HL level 4 OR FAL level 5. English: English HL level 4 OR FAL level 5. SETM: Setswana/Sesotho/Sepedi HL level 4. ATSN: none. Split by campus. No maths requirement.
